title: Three-bedroom apartment fit-out
description: Ceilings, lighting, wardrobes and wall finishes for a family moving in before the school term. Electrical and carpentry ran in parallel to save two weeks.

title: Office floor rewire
description: A 6,000 sq ft floor rewired overnight in phases, with a new distribution board, UPS circuits and load test certificates issued on completion.

title: Cafe kitchen build-out
description: Grease-trap drainage, anti-skid flooring, exhaust ducting and wall cladding completed ahead of a fixed licence inspection date.

title: Modular kitchen and pantry
description: BWP ply carcasses, acrylic shutters and soft-close hardware, measured and built around an existing window and gas line.

title: Residential block repaint
description: Crack filling, waterproof primer and exterior emulsion across four blocks, with scaffolding sequenced so no stairwell was closed for more than a day.

title: Two bathrooms replumbed
description: Concealed pipework replaced after a slab leak, pressure tested, then tiled and refitted by our own tiling and carpentry teams.

title: Warehouse maintenance contract
description: Quarterly inspection of electrics, roof drainage, shutters and fire pumps, with a written condition report after every visit.

title: Villa doors and joinery
description: Fourteen solid-core doors, frames and a staircase balustrade made to site measurements and finished in melamine on site.

title: Retail shop fit-out
description: Display joinery, track lighting, signage backing and flooring for a 900 sq ft unit, handed over between two trading weekends.
